summary: Global-E Online Ltd. furnished a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated October 1, 2026, announcing that Tomer Gold, previously EVP of the SMB Channel division, became Chief Revenue Officer effective October 1, 2026. Ran Fridman, the company's first CRO, departs after more than five years for another opportunity. No price, stake, premium, advisor or board recommendation is stated. The change is an internal promotion, not a forced or abrupt CEO/CFO exit. Watch for any subsequent 6-K or 20-F disclosure on severance terms, equity forfeitures or further commercial-leadership turnover.
